text: VLCS retained all 30 registered architecture, class-split, and seed cells. Its primary gate failed. ResNet18 produced zero registered utility contrast under both protection settings. For ConvNeXt-Tiny, the full-simplex contrast was 0.164 percentage points, with a descriptive 95% interval from 0.027 to 0.356 percentage points, below the predeclared 1.00-point minimum. Because the protocol was locally pre-specified rather than externally registered, and because near-duplicate and ImageNet-pretraining overlap were not excluded, this is an adverse fixed-frame result rather than an independent population replication.
